title: 第1章 重生
content_zh:
他是一个无父无母的孤儿，没有名字，从他记事起，在四岁的时候，就已经能够在垃圾堆里跟野猫、野狗抢食，即使被抓咬得伤痕累累，但是依然很坚强地活了下来。

他希望自己能够像仙人一样，飞天遁地，排山倒海，无所不能，改变自己的命运，所以把自己的名字取为轩辕，因为在某一次，乞讨的时候，他曾经听到一名算命的老瞎子，喃喃自语，轩辕大帝，力压八荒，四夷臣服，一代人皇……

在他五岁那年，有一个老乞丐好心带着他一起当小乞丐，这老乞丐还真的是打心眼里疼他，教会了他很多生存之道，在轩辕七岁的时候，便让他去上学，老乞丐告诉轩辕。

“我已经老了，离死也不远了，但我不能让你跟我当一辈子的叫花子，让人看不起，害了你一辈子啊，只有读书才是唯一的出路，你是一个聪明的孩子，只要你肯读书，以后长大了，进了大城市，水灵灵的姑娘站成一排让你选都可以，不用跟着老乞丐我偷看赵寡妇洗澡那么寒碜了……”

在上学的第一天，轩辕是一边走一边哭着去上学的，这孩子也聪明，不管是语文、数学、英语几乎都是一点就通，成绩优越到连跳两级，一直到高中学习成绩都是全市状元，学校知道了他的情况，是特困生，便免他所有的一切学费，还有不少的补助。

可惜老天不长眼，当轩辕能够靠自己读书赚来一些小钱孝敬与自己相依为命多年的老乞丐的时候，老乞丐却是在一个特别严寒的冬天给冻死了。

轩辕咬着牙，顶住严寒，将老乞丐的尸体拖到一个无人的地方，扛着苦，忍着眼泪，用双并不大的双手，挖着被冻结的硬土，挖得一手鲜血淋淋，一个人把老乞丐给埋了，眼睛里噙满了泪水，带着哭腔呜咽道：

“老乞…丐，你一个人走了，一定…很…很孤单吧，你说好人…会有好报的！为什么…你会死啊！是轩辕…没用，轩辕…没能让你过上…好日子，报答你…对轩辕的恩情，希望你…下辈子，可以一生…安稳…幸福，不用颠沛流离。”

说着说着，轩辕就哇哇大哭了起来。

听一个算命的说，给一个命苦的好人磕一百个头，那么那个人来生的命就会变得好了，所以那瘦弱单薄的身影，在冰天雪地中倔着骨，一下一下的磕头，给老乞丐磕了百来个头，只希望老乞丐来世能够三餐温饱，安稳幸福。

老乞丐坟前的雪地，被磕出了一片片浅红色的血迹，轩辕站起身来，额头血迹斑斑，双目空洞，眼泪抑制不住地往下滚落，弱小的身躯摇晃着，在茫茫雪地之中，一步一步地走着，轩辕心中悲痛，他不知道接下来自己应该怎么过，这么多年来，跟老乞丐相依为命，只要跟在老乞丐，哪里都是家，老乞丐一死了，轩辕觉得自己无家可归了，心中绝望。

鹅毛大雪下得很紧，轩辕一脚一脚地踏在雪地里，头晕脑胀，浑身发冷，冻僵，没有方向地走着，最后终于支撑不住，倒在了雪地里，被无情的大雪给淹没了，连一个小坟包都没有。

茫茫一缕魂魄，飘荡在一片阴沉在天空之中，这一道魂魄正是昏倒在冰天雪地被风雪覆盖的轩辕，轩辕感觉到自己的身体轻飘飘的悬浮着，好像一切都已经由不得自己了。

朝着身下看去，这是一片荒凉的乱葬岗上，横七竖八安静地躺着千百具尸体，死气沉沉，没有丝毫的生机，一大群乌鸦，秃鹫正在啄食着一具具已经开始腐烂的尸体。

“这里怎么会有这么多的死人，难道我已经死了吗？”轩辕惨笑了一声，看着自己的双手，可以透过自己的双手，看到身下无数的死人，看来自己的确已经死了。

然而就在这时，突然一头浑身长着银白色毛发的孤狼突然冲了过来，惊起了一大群乌鸦与秃鹫，连忙飞上了一棵棵枯树的枝桠上，嘎嘎地叫了起来，朝着那一头银白色毛发的孤狼示威咆哮着。

孤狼没有丝毫的理会，只是来到了一名少年的身边，在他身上闻了几下之后，坐在他的身旁，仰天悲嘶，那一群乌鸦与秃鹫突然安静了下来。

在孤狼旁边的少年，脸色苍白，面容坚毅，身体上有许多伤痕，衣服已是破破烂烂的了，但是在少年的腰间，别着一把黑色中沾染着点点铁锈的匕首，没有一丝的锋芒，在少年的身上，已经没有了任何的生气了。

孤狼一直守在少年的身边，仰天悲嘶，似乎在乞求上苍。

也许是因为孤狼的乞求得到上苍的回应，忽然之间，少年腰间的那一把黑色生着铁锈的匕首，细微地颤动了一下，陡然之间，一股诡异的力量运转了起来，一股莫名的吸力，直接抓住了轩辕的魂魄，轩辕骤然一惊，还没等轩辕回过神来，轩辕感觉突然身体一沉，不再是像刚才那样，轻飘飘的感觉了。

睁开双眼，轩辕看到了阴沉的天空，朦朦胧胧，突然感觉到一阵阵头痛，无数的记忆从自己的脑海中闪过，轩辕感觉到自己的脑子仿佛快要爆炸开来一样。

紧接着，看到四面八方，躺着无数的尸体，空气中弥漫着一股腐尸的恶臭，让轩辕仿轩辕仿佛被踩到尾巴的猫，一下子跳了起来！

“到底是怎么回事，我不是已经死了吗？不管怎么样，先离开这里在说！”

这是轩辕的第一个念头，他越过了无数的尸体，朝着一片森林的方向奔逃而去，感觉到腐尸的恶臭之味越来越淡了，无数的尸体也淡出自己的视线之后，来到了一处阴气森森的森林边缘后，轩辕这才突然发现，全身上下仿佛都快要被撕裂开来一样的疼痛。

再也无力跑动了，双腿一软，砰的一声闷响，一屁股坐在了一棵树的下面，大口大口地喘着粗气，这时的轩辕，才发现自己身边跟着一头体形有藏獒大小的孤狼，吓了一大跳，突然之间，在轩辕的记忆之中，闪过了这一头孤狼的名字，以及自己与它的生活经历，刚才自己也看在了这头孤狼守护在一具少年尸体的身旁。

听到轩辕的呼唤，孤狼的眸子变得越加的灵动，呜呜地长啸了几声，回应着轩辕。

轩辕感觉到自己的声音变得陌生了，而且脑海之中也多出了许多，不是他的记忆，但是目前最要紧的就是，填饱肚子。

“孤星，我饿了，实在走不动了，你帮我找点吃的。”轩辕抱着一丝希望，有气无力地说着，肚子很配合得发出咕咕咕得声响。

孤星仿佛能够听懂轩辕的话，立即朝着森林里奔跑而去，轩辕诧异了一下孤星的灵性，不过这都符合自己莫名的记忆。

轩辕决定，趁着孤星为自己寻找食物的时间里，好好整理一下自己的思绪。

“难道我刚才，直接附身到了这名死去的少年身上，直接重生了，这到底是怎么回事？”

自己的身后是一片森林，眼前是一片乱葬岗。

脑海里，一道道画面显现了出来，如走马灯一样闪过，发现了，这并不是属于自己所存在的世界。

原来，这具身体的主人，跟自己的身世差不多，十四岁，自小苦苦挣扎，只为生存，无依无靠，孤身一人，饱受欺凌，却没有任何的名字，在一次意外中，拣到了腰间这一把沾染满铁锈的匕首，看起来一点也不锋利的匕首，却能够削铁如泥，而且似乎还蕴藏着极其神奇的力量。

在自己现在深处的这一片森林，名为魔兽森林，在这一片魔兽深处的无数大山之中，隐藏着无数凶悍的魔兽，就连他都也只敢在森林外面猎杀这些相对来讲，野兽，或者比较低级的魔兽，因为有不少的野兽、魔兽都会前往乱葬岗去吃掉那些尸体，他便抓准机会，杀掉野兽、魔兽，以它们的皮毛去月荒城当中去换取斗者币。

然而就在前几天，他与孤星、孤月配合，猎杀了一头魔虎，但是孤月也在这一场战斗中被咬成了重伤，他心急如焚，解剖了魔虎，想要以魔虎皮毛去换取一些疗伤药来救孤月，意外得到了一颗内丹。

内丹极为珍贵，有时候杀了一百头魔兽也不可能得到一颗内丹，在他看来，这简直就是一根救命稻草。

惊喜之下，让孤星守着孤月，自己急急忙忙一个人跑到月荒城里准备卖了内丹，就能够买到更好的药救活孤月了，不曾想这内丹之中，魔虎的气息，惊动了月家少爷月绝车驾的骏马，月绝见这魔虎内丹品质极为了得，就以自己冲撞了他的车驾为缘由，让月家的恶奴给活活打成重伤奄奄一息，就连身上那一颗魔虎的内丹也被月家少爷给抢了过去把玩，一句话把迷迷糊糊之中的他丢到乱葬岗！

“大胆贱民，竟然敢惊了本公子的宝马，不要打死他，打成重伤就好，然后把他丢到了乱葬岗，让那些畜生把他生吃了，唯有这样，才能解本公子的心头之恨。”

就在这样，在孤星的守护之下，自己的身体才没有被生吃了，但是却因为无人治疗，就这样，断气死了，可是就是自己断气死了，孤星也没有放弃守护的自己的尸体。

知道了这一切，轩辕怒笑了起来，这是什么世道？难道没有天理王法了吗？这月绝竟然如此的残忍，轩辕怒气填胸，狰狞地咆哮着：

“罢了，都是孤苦无依之人，我占了你的身躯，我就是你，你就是我，来到这一个莫名的世界，没有了回头路，这个月绝，我绝对不会放过他，迟早有一天，我要成为像轩辕大帝那样的存在，执掌天下，龙战于野，其血玄黄，从今日起，以轩辕之名，斩灭一切阻挡在我面前的阻碍！”

就在这时，也不知道是不是轩辕的运气不好，感觉到地面剧烈地震动了起来。

转头看去，自右侧一只高三米的魔熊一旁奔袭了过来，狰狞的面容，尖锐的獠牙，朝着轩辕一口咬来！

轩辕大惊，浑身的汗毛炸起，一股凉气直冲脑门。
content_en:
He is a fatherless and motherless orphan with no name. From the time he can remember, when he was four years old, he has been able to fight for food with wild cats and dogs in garbage dumps. Even though he was scratched and bitten, he still survived very strongly.

He hoped that he could fly to the sky and escape the earth like an immortal, conquer mountains and seas, be omnipotent, and change his destiny, so he named himself Xuanyuan because once, when he was begging, he heard an old blind fortune teller muttering to himself, Emperor Xuanyuan, overwhelming the eight wastelands, all the barbarians surrendered, a generation of human emperors...

When he was five years old, an old beggar kindly took him to be a little beggar. The old beggar really loved him from the bottom of his heart and taught him many ways to survive. When Xuanyuan was seven years old, he let him go to school. The old beggar told Xuanyuan.

"I'm old, and I'm not far away from death, but I can't let you be a beggar with me for the rest of your life, making people look down on you, and hurting you for the rest of your life. Studying is the only way out. You are a smart child. As long as you are willing to study, when you grow up and enter a big city, you can choose from all the pretty girls standing in a row. You don't have to follow the old beggar. I peeked at Widow Zhao taking a bath. She is so shabby..."

On the first day of school, Xuanyuan went to school crying while walking. This child was also smart. He was almost proficient in Chinese, mathematics, and English. His grades were so good that he even skipped two grades. In high school, he was the top student in the city. When the school knew about his situation and that he was an extremely poor student, he was exempted from all tuition fees and received a lot of subsidies.

It's a pity that God is not discerning. When Xuanyuan was able to earn some small money by studying to honor the old beggar who had depended on him for many years, the old beggar froze to death in a particularly cold winter.

Xuanyuan gritted his teeth and withstood the severe cold, dragging the old beggar's body to a deserted place. Carrying the pain and holding back his tears, he dug into the frozen hard soil with his small hands until his hands were dripping with blood. He buried the old beggar alone, his eyes filled with tears, and he sobbed:

"Old beggar... beggar, you must be... very... lonely if you go alone. You said that good people... will be rewarded! Why... you will die! It's Xuanyuan... useless, Xuanyuan... can't let you live... a good life. To repay your... kindness to Xuanyuan, I hope that in your next life, you can be... stable... happy, and don't have to live in exile."

As he spoke, Xuanyuan burst into tears.

I heard a fortune teller say that if you kowtow a hundred times to a good person who has a miserable life, then that person's life will become better in the next life. So that thin and frail figure, stubborn in the ice and snow, kowtowed to the old beggar a hundred times, hoping that the old beggar could have three meals of food and clothing, be stable and happy in the next life.

On the snow in front of the old beggar's grave, there were patches of light red blood. Xuanyuan stood up, his forehead was stained with blood, his eyes were hollow, tears rolled down uncontrollably, his weak body swayed, walking step by step in the vast snow.With this, Xuanyuan felt sad in his heart. He didn't know how he should live next. For so many years, he had been dependent on the old beggar. As long as he stayed with the old beggar, he would feel at home wherever he was. Once the old beggar died, Xuanyuan felt that he was homeless and despaired in his heart.

The heavy snowfall was heavy. Xuanyuan stepped on the snow one foot after another. He felt dizzy, his whole body was cold, and he was frozen. He walked without direction. Finally, he couldn't hold on anymore and fell to the snow. He was submerged by the ruthless heavy snow without even a small grave.

A vast wisp of soul floated in the gloomy sky. This soul was Xuanyuan who passed out in the ice and snow covered by wind and snow. Xuanyuan felt that his body was floating lightly, as if everything could no longer be controlled by him.

Looking down, it was a desolate mass grave. Thousands of corpses were lying quietly in various directions. They were lifeless and lifeless. A large group of crows and vultures were pecking at the corpses that had begun to rot.

"Why are there so many dead people here? Am I already dead?" Xuanyuan laughed miserably and looked at his hands. Through his hands, he could see countless dead people under him. It seemed that he was indeed dead.

However, at this moment, a lone wolf with silver-white hair suddenly rushed over, startling a large group of crows and vultures, and quickly flew onto the branches of the dead trees, squawking, and roaring at the lone wolf with silver-white hair.

The lone wolf didn't pay any attention to it, and just came to a young man's side. After smelling him a few times, he sat next to him and looked up to the sky and hissed sadly. The group of crows and vultures suddenly became quiet.

The young man next to the lone wolf had a pale face and a resolute face. There were many scars on his body and his clothes were in tatters. However, on the young man's waist, there was a black dagger stained with rust. There was no trace of edge. There was no life in the young man's body.

The lone wolf always stayed by the boy's side, looking up to the sky and hissing in grief, as if begging God.

Perhaps it was because the lone wolf's begging was answered by God. Suddenly, the black rusty dagger on the young man's waist trembled slightly. Suddenly, a strange force began to operate. An inexplicable suction force directly grabbed Xuanyuan's soul.

Opening his eyes, Xuanyuan saw the gloomy sky, hazy, and suddenly felt a headache. Countless memories flashed through his mind, and Xuanyuan felt as if his brain was about to explode.

Immediately afterwards, he saw countless corpses lying in all directions, and the air was filled with the stench of rotting corpses. Xuanyuan jumped up like a cat whose tail had been stepped on!

"What's going on? Am I already dead? No matter what, let's get out of here first!"

This was Xuanyuan's first thought. He crossed countless corpses and ran toward a forest. He felt that the stench of the rotting corpses was getting weaker and weaker. After countless corpses also faded out of his sight, when he came to the edge of a gloomy forest, Xuanyuan suddenly discovered that his entire body was in pain as if it was about to be torn apart.

No longer able to run, his legs gave out, and with a muffled sound, he sat down under a tree, breathing heavily. At this moment, Xuanyuan realized that a lone wolf the size of a Tibetan mastiff was following him. He was startled. Suddenly, in Xuanyuan's memory, the name of this lone wolf and his life experience with it flashed through. Just now, he had seen this lone wolf guarding the body of a young man.

Hearing Xuanyuan's call, Lone Wolf's eyes became more and more alert, and he whined several times in response to Xuanyuan.

Xuanyuan felt that his voice had become unfamiliar, and there were many more things in his mind that were not his memories, but the most important thing at the moment was to fill his stomach.

"Lone Star, I'm hungry. I really can't walk. Please help me find something to eat." Xuanyuan said feebly, holding a glimmer of hope, and his stomach made a growling sound.

Lone Star seemed to be able to understand Xuanyuan's words and immediately ran towards the forest. Xuanyuan was surprised by Lone Star's spirituality, but it was all consistent with his inexplicable memory.

Xuanyuan decided to sort out his thoughts while Lone Star was looking for food for him.

"Did I just possess the dead boy and be reborn? What on earth is going on?"

Behind him is a forest, and in front of him is a mass grave.

Picture after picture appeared in my mind, flashing by like a revolving lantern, and I realized that this was not the world I existed in.

It turned out that the owner of this body was similar to his own life experience. He was fourteen years old, struggling hard since he was a child, just for survival, helpless, alone, bullied, but without any name. In an accident, he picked up this rust-stained dagger on his waist. The dagger didn't look sharp at all, but it could cut iron as well as mud, and it seemed to contain extremely magical power.

The forest deep inside him is called the Warcraft Forest. There are countless ferocious Warcraft hidden in the countless mountains deep in the Warcraft. Even he only dares to hunt these relatively beasts or relatively low-level Warcraft outside the forest. Because many beasts and Warcraft will go to the mass graves to eat the corpses, he seizes the opportunity to kill the beasts and Warcraft, and exchange their skins for Fighter Coins in Yuehuang City.

However, just a few days ago, he cooperated with Gu Xing and Gu Yue to hunt down a demon tiger, but Gu Yue was also bitten and seriously injured in this battle. He was so anxious that he dissected the demon tiger, hoping to exchange the demon tiger fur for some healing medicine to save Gu Yue, but accidentally got an inner elixir.

The inner elixir is extremely precious. Sometimes it is impossible to get even one inner elixir even if you kill a hundred monsters. In his opinion, this is simply a life-saving straw.

Surprised, he asked Lone Star to guard Lone Moon, and hurriedly ran to Yuehuang City alone to sell the inner elixir, so that he could buy better medicine to save Lone Yue. He never thought that the aura of the devil tiger in the inner elixir would alert the horse driven by the young master of the Yue family, Yue Jue, and Yue Jue saw the devil tiger.The inner elixir was of extremely high quality, so he was beaten alive by the evil slaves of the Yue family until he was seriously injured and dying on the pretext that he rammed into his car. Even the inner elixir of the devil tiger on his body was snatched away by the young master of the Yue family to play with, and he was thrown into a mass grave in a daze!

"The brave bitch dared to frighten my young master's BMW. Don't beat him to death, just seriously injure him. Then he threw him into a mass grave and let those beasts eat him alive. Only in this way can we relieve the hatred in my heart."

Just like this, under the protection of Lone Star, his body was not eaten alive, but because there was no one to treat him, he died like this. But even after he died, Lone Star did not give up protecting his body.

Knowing all this, Xuanyuan laughed angrily, what kind of world is this?Is there no law of heaven?This Yue Jue turned out to be so cruel. Xuanyuan was filled with anger and roared ferociously:

"Forget it, they are all lonely and helpless people. I took over your body. I am you and you are me. I came to this inexplicable world. There is no way back. This Yue Jue, I will never let him go. Sooner or later, I will become a being like Emperor Xuanyuan. I will rule the world. Dragons fight in the wild, and their blood is black and yellow. From today on, in the name of Xuanyuan, I will destroy all obstacles in front of me!"

At this moment, whether it was due to Xuanyuan's bad luck or not, he felt the ground shaking violently.

Turning around, he saw a three-meter-tall demonic bear running towards Xuanyuan from the right, with a ferocious face and sharp fangs!

Xuanyuan was shocked, the hairs all over his body stood up, and a gust of cold air rushed straight to his forehead.
